Entry below main-book threshold: SH (eff_conf=0.00, regime=trending_down) — 6 occurrences at 15:20-15:30 UTC
target_symbols.evidence: SH was produced as a candidate 8 times. Every time, eff_conf=0.00 because breakout_readiness=0 and squeeze_momentum=0. Inverse ETFs don't exhibit breakout patterns — they move inversely to the market in a gradual fashion. The confidence formula (0.65*breakout + 0.35*tension) will ALWAYS produce near-zero for SH unless the market crashes sharply enough to trigger a tension score.
target_symbols.structural_issue: The confidence formula has NO component that can detect inverse-ETF worthiness. Regime alignment contributes 5% to alpha score but does NOT flow into the confidence formula at all.

rejection_reasons: Liquidity gate blocked COST — 10+ occurrences across session (15:16-17:14 UTC)
target_symbols.evidence: COST was blocked by the liquidity gate every time it appeared. The gate requires min 10,000 shares avg volume over last 20 bars. COST trades at ~$1,000/share, so dollar volume is high but share volume is low. This is a known edge case with high-priced stocks.
target_symbols.structural_issue: Liquidity gate uses share volume, not dollar volume. COST at $1,000 with 8,000 shares/bar = $8M/bar — more than liquid enough. But the gate sees < 10,000 shares and blocks.
